canvas.evidence: ketvoice_media_overrides holds the owner's rows saved at 19:01-19:02 UTC (album and titles with a canvas link, titles with canvas_off): saving worked
canvas.cause: CanvasRepo.resolve kept whatever Canvas was already on the device for a title (the catalogue's file, reloaded from preferences at each launch) and returned before looking at the owner's choice; only an earlier choice stored as a file was ever replaced
canvas.fix: the Canvas shown gives way whenever it is not the one the owner's choice calls for, or when a choice was removed
canvas.persistence: overrides live on the server and in a local cache independent of the app version; nothing in an update removes them
canvas.not_verified: not seen on a device; whether the owner's link host serves a streamable MP4 to the phone was not checked

gaps_in_background.cause: not established: no log or device trace was available
mitigations: audio track buffer 0.5-1 s instead of Media3's 0.25-0.75 s
Ketmix reads titles at 3x instead of 8x while the activity is stopped
gaps_in_background.side_effect: what follows the sound through the meter (reactive visuals) may run up to a quarter of a second further ahead of what is heard

ketmix.found: DeckMixProcessor rebuilt its DSP at every flush; Media3 flushes processors at each playback-speed change, which a blend in time makes many times: filter state, echo and reverb buffers were lost each time
changes: DSP kept across flushes, reset only after a jump of more than 1.5 s in the title
ride of the common tempo in 1 % steps
audible nudges only beyond 18 ms and at most every 1.2 s
journal: worst beat gap and number of speed changes
ketmix.unknown: whether this is what the owner hears as 'horrible' is not known: nothing was heard here and no description or journal came with the report; two separate audio tracks cannot be locked to the sample, which may itself be audible on drums

owner_section_changes: A Canvas chosen by the owner now replaces the Canvas already on the device for that title (see owner_report_2026_11_15_third.canvas).
known_limitations: Owner-section changes are deliberately not mentioned in the public release notes (owner preference).
A Canvas given as a link depends on the site that serves it: if it goes away or refuses streaming, nothing plays behind the title.
Ketmix needs the next title to be playable without a new resolution or one that succeeds in time; otherwise it says so and the title ends as before.
A manual skip is still a plain change of title: it is not mixed.
The mix journal is kept in memory only and is lost when the app is closed.

Ket 27 is an alpha: settings, switch, alerts, tab bar, colours and type follow iOS 27; page layouts elsewhere (Home, Library, album, player, sheets, menus) keep Ketvoice's own structure. No iPad sidebar, no minimised tab bar change, no new haptics.
Titles under 150 s and the light analysis setting get no body reading; 3:2 and 4:3 tempo relations between two different titles are still not mixed in time.
Reading the body of two titles adds about 5 to 10 seconds of silent decoding before each new pair.
The signing certificate is the existing public Android debug identity, not a private production key.
